note: B6 story questions (FLUENCY_LOOP_PLAN.md). DRAFT written for the owner to review or replace before freezing. Each story is read in full, then each question is asked; gold answers are the name or noun phrase a reader would give (any listed form counts).

stories.text: Mira had a small red boat. One morning her brother Tomas borrowed the boat without asking. He rowed it across the lake to the island. When he came back, Mira was waiting on the dock. She made him promise to ask first next time.
qs: Where did Tomas row the boat?
Who was waiting on the dock?

stories.text: The baker, Mr. Hollis, opened his shop at dawn. A girl named Petra came in and bought two loaves of bread. She paid with a silver coin. Mr. Hollis gave her a roll for free because it was her birthday.

A fox saw a crow sitting in a tree with a piece of cheese. The fox told the crow that her voice must be beautiful. The crow opened her beak to sing, and the cheese fell to the ground. The fox ate the cheese and ran away.
Leon lost his keys on the way to school. His friend Ada found them under a bench in the park. She gave them back to Leon at lunch. Leon thanked her and shared his apple with her.
qs: under a bench in the park
When did Ada return the keys?

stories.text: The old king had three daughters. The youngest, Elin, was the bravest. When a dragon came to the valley, Elin rode out alone to meet it. She did not fight the dragon; she offered it gold, and the dragon flew away.
qs: How many daughters did the king have?
What did Elin offer the dragon?

stories.text: Grandma Rosa planted tomatoes in the spring. In summer, a rabbit started eating the leaves. Her grandson Nico built a fence around the garden. After that, the rabbit ate clover in the field instead.
qs: What did the rabbit eat after that?

stories.text: Captain Ortiz steered the ship through the storm. The sailor Bram climbed the mast to fix a torn sail. A wave knocked Bram's hat into the sea. In the morning the sky was clear and the ship reached the harbor.
Sana wanted to learn the violin. Her teacher, Mrs. Kato, gave her one lesson every Tuesday. After a year, Sana played a song at the school concert. Her father recorded the concert on his phone.
qs: What did Sana want to learn?
Where did Sana play a song?

stories.text: A tortoise challenged a hare to a race. The hare ran far ahead and then lay down to sleep. The tortoise walked slowly but never stopped. When the hare woke up, the tortoise had already crossed the finish line.
qs: Who challenged whom to a race?
What did the hare do after running ahead?

stories.text: Dr. Amari worked at the hospital in the city. One night a boy named Felix arrived with a broken arm. Dr. Amari set the bone and put his arm in a cast. Felix's mother brought the doctor a cake the next week.
qs: at the hospital in the city
To whom did she bring it?

stories.text: The village had one well. In a dry summer the well ran low. Old Petr remembered a spring in the hills, and he led the villagers there. They dug a channel, and water flowed to the village again.
qs: What did the village have only one of?
Why did the well run low?

stories.text: Jun found a lost puppy in the rain. He carried it home and dried it with a towel. His sister Hana made a bed for it from an old box. The next day they put up signs, and the owner, Mrs. Bell, came to take the puppy home.
qs: What did Jun dry it with?
Who made a bed for the puppy?
What was the bed made from?

stories.text: The painter Lucia painted a portrait of the mayor. The mayor did not like his nose in the picture. Lucia painted it again, and this time the mayor smiled. He hung the portrait in the town hall.

Two friends, Omar and Ines, went hiking in the mountains. Ines twisted her ankle on a rock. Omar carried her backpack and helped her walk down slowly. At the bottom, a ranger drove them to the town in a jeep.

A miller had a clever cat. When the miller died, his youngest son received only the cat. The cat asked for a pair of boots and a bag. With them it caught rabbits and gave them to the king, and the king soon invited the son to the palace.
qs: What did the cat ask for?
a pair of boots and a bag
What did the cat give the king?
Who was invited to the palace?

stories.text: Teo forgot his lunch at home. At noon his classmate Zoe gave him half of her sandwich. The next day Teo brought two oranges and gave one to Zoe.
qs: Who gave Teo half a sandwich?
What did Teo bring the next day?

stories.text: The lighthouse keeper, Agnes, saw a small boat in trouble near the rocks. She rang the bell and called the rescue team. The team pulled two fishermen from the water. The fishermen later gave Agnes a basket of fish.
qs: Who was pulled from the water?

stories.text: Professor Lind lost an important letter in the library. The librarian, Mr. Ruiz, searched every shelf. He found the letter inside a dictionary. The professor rewarded him with a book about birds.

A lion caught a little mouse. The mouse begged to be let go and promised to help the lion one day. The lion laughed and let it go. Later the lion was trapped in a net, and the mouse chewed the ropes until the lion was free.
qs: to help the lion one day

stories.text: Eva and her uncle Karl drove to the coast on Saturday. Karl wanted to fish, but Eva wanted to swim. They agreed to fish in the morning and swim in the afternoon. In the evening they cooked the fish they caught over a fire on the beach.
qs: What did they do in the afternoon?
Where did they cook the fish?
over a fire on the beach
